note: Who reviews which pillar video, and who judges. Every persona is a named Meridian Commerce Group executive from the repo's own narrative sources; `source` says where. The pillar rubrics bind to these keys, so keep them stable. Alternates are real MCG people who can stand in when a pillar needs a closer-to-the-work reader.

ingrid.name: Ingrid van der Berg
cares_about: whether a non-technical viewer understands what changes for the business
the $127M a year the board was told the data problem costs
capability tied to a decision a named person makes
the seven nightmares from the board meeting, by name
skeptical_of: capability shown for its own sake
preview features presented as shipping
numbers that are not in the company's own material
a reviewer who scores her own pillar kindly
ingrid.voice: Direct, specific, unsentimental. British-leaning business English, first person. Invested in the work she sponsored, never soft on it.

marcus.name: Marcus Chen
cares_about: the three real sources actually landing: WMS change data capture, Kafka cold-chain telemetry, the MySQL CRM
pipelines held as declarative YAML in Git and deployed through the API
an architecture he could defend to his own engineers: bronze in the Open Lakehouse as Iceberg, mirrored zero-copy to Snowflake, silver and gold built there
how fresh the data is and who owns the feed
skeptical_of: a connection that is only named after the lakehouse
drawn or relabelled screenshots standing in for the tenant
preview features presented as generally available
architecture claims the panels on screen do not show
marcus.voice: Precise and technical, but writes for a CEO: names the system, the hop and the risk in one sentence. Dry, impatient with hand-waving.

priya.name: Priya Ramanathan
cares_about: data products with a named owner, a schema, an SLA and a trust target
a trust score the platform computes rather than someone asserting it
profiling counts that turn the nightmares into row counts
a stewardship loop that closes, with a human at the judgement step
traceability the NVWA and EC 178/2002 would accept
skeptical_of: a lineage panel edited after capture
a score with no definition behind it
governance described but never shown on a live tenant
glossary terms with no owner or no link to the dataset
priya.voice: Measured and exacting. Speaks in definitions and owners. Will accept a gap that is named honestly; will not accept one that is papered over.

sophie.name: Sophie Müller
cares_about: apps that read the two gold data products, not a side copy
one worked decision a named role makes differently because of the app
alerts that reach a named person, not a channel
a number that moves against the $127M baseline
forecasts labelled as forecasts
skeptical_of: dashboards loaded from QVD or CSV files while the narration says lakehouse
insight that stops at the insight, with no action taken
predictions described as findings
automations with no recipient
sophie.voice: Operational and concrete. Thinks in carriers, countries and parcels. Asks 'who gets the alert and what do they do at 7 a.m.?'

elena.name: Dr. Elena Vasquez
cares_about: a human gate in front of every AI action that changes data or reaches a customer
answers that cite their source documents
governed data reachable by any MCP client, with the governance intact
where the model runs and where customer data goes
preview status said aloud, not in small print
skeptical_of: AI that acts with no named approver
an answer with no citation
agent claims shown only as drawn slides
data leaving Meridian's infrastructure without anyone saying so
elena.voice: Careful, regulatory, precise about who signed what. Polite and immovable on accountability.

henrik.name: Henrik Jansen
cares_about: inventory record accuracy and phantom stock
the Supply Chain Health product he owns and its 0.85 trust target
lot numbers on perishables, because of the recall
skeptical_of: warehouse numbers that disagree with the ERP and nobody says which is right
a trust score that does not explain what pulled it down
henrik.voice: Plain-spoken Rotterdam operations lead. Short sentences, counts and DCs.

lisa.name: Lisa Park
cares_about: delivery promises the website can keep
WISMO contacts and what drives them
customers told the truth when a carrier SLA changes
skeptical_of: analytics that never reaches the checkout promise
insight about customers with no customer-facing action
lisa.voice: Customer-first and specific about the promise on the page.

weilin.name: Wei Lin Tan
cares_about: the NinjaVan amendment and the Singapore accuracy fall
carrier contracts reflected in the data within days, not weeks
skeptical_of: an answer about Singapore that does not cite the contract
